text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ――Phew. We finally made it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To wash away our daily exhaustion,
two trainers arrived at the hot springs,
and yet――

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I looked into the therapeutic properties beforehand, and the water quality here is quite extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If it's like this, using it for the team training camp
is an option.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
We had planned on a day trip, but if there's an opening,
perhaps we should stay the night.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Yes. Trying the food ourselves will allow us to properly verify the ingredients and flavor profile.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: We managed to secure a room without issue, and the food and hot springs were wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
How long has it been
since I spent time this leisurely...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Much less that my opponent would be you.
...I never could have imagined it.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...There is a vast difference between you and me.
From our philosophies on Umamusume, to everything else.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, even if it happens again... No, precisely because of that,
I believe we can still learn from each other.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I am watching. Watching your methods.
I shall devote myself so that I never forget them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Now then, regarding our future course,
what is your opinion—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Beep beep beep)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me. That's my phone.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse? What is it?
...Ah, that matter is scheduled for tomorrow afternoon as planned.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where am I right now...?
Well, um...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! Please don't misunderstand!
We are strictly fellow Trainers—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Listen to me, making friends is an unnecessary—
Ah, wait... Hello?! Hello!!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...We head back to the academy first thing tomorrow morning.
Please have your things ready so you can move quickly as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, we left the inn before sunrise.
...Her movements were sharper and swifter
than anything I had ever seen before.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame we couldn't get a room,
but it was so last-minute, it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Well, I enjoyed the hot springs.
They were spacious, convenient, and the floor wasn't slippery.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
With this, I can bring my students here
without any worries.
choice_data_list: You really cherish your students, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Naturally.
Though wouldn't that apply to you as well?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If it is to protect those girls,
I am prepared to use any means necessary.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of bending this mindset.
However, that does not mean it is set in stone forever.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
There is change within me, as well.
Just as those girls grow with each passing day.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Unless I learn much and hone myself as well,
I cannot carve out a future for these Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Even if most people do not understand,
we must pave a path so that the Umamusume never stumble.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I believe that is my duty as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Talk about bold, saying that to me.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Still, as a Tracen Academy Trainer,
you need that level of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I look forward to seeing what you accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Come, let us head home.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
For their sake,
I must draft a meticulous plan for the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With visions of our trainee Uma Musume in mind,
the two of us hurried back toward the academy.
